notes.title: This update brings a variety of improvements and fixes
notes.content:
Improved several song covers, selection menu and album covers
 Added a new hit effect in Boxing Mode to improve the visibility of oncoming targets.
 Optimized the laser effects to look better.
 Added a hint text for the "Play" button to make it clearer for new players.
 Fixed a bug where songs would occasionally fail to reload after showing the introductory tutorial.


Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: BOXING MODE out now!
notes.content:
SolarBlack Update v1.5 – BOXING MODE, New Songs, Worlds & More!
This new update packs a punch! Get ready to move, groove, and throw some combos with our brand-new BOXING MODE!

[previewyoutube=gMhefr8irZo;full][/previewyoutube]

STEP INTO THE RING
Think you’ve got the speed, precision, and endurance to dominate the leaderboard? BOXING MODE is here to test your reflexes with jabs, hooks, and uppercuts—all to the beat! Plus, your stance will now dynamically switch between orthodox and southpaw to give you a full-body workout.

NEW SONGS
We’re bringing classical elegance with two incredible new tracks:

 'Blue Danube' – Richard Strauss
 'The Flower Duet' – Léo Delibes


EXPLORE TWO STUNNING NEW ENVIRONMENTS

 Reyoarfjorour, Iceland – Enjoy the serenity of the Reyoarfjorour waterfalls, where nature and music combine perfectly for the most immersive rhythmic journey.
 Zwettl, Austria – Travel through this winter wonderland while you slice, shoot, and box to the beat!


CRAVING VARIETY? TRY THE "RANDOM" BUTTON
Spice up your stage! Shuffle your environment with the new Random button and keep each playthrough fresh!

OTHER UPDATES & IMPROVEMENTS

 Better Song Organization – Sorted tracks for easier navigation.
 Previous Song Selection – Your last chosen song stays pre-selected in the World Hub.
 Fix Height Adjustment – Improved spawn height for a more comfortable experience.
 Renamed "No-Fail" to "Practice" – Clarity in training modes.
 Enhanced Visuals – New glass shader for arrows, platform shadows, improved platform shader, and anti-aliased UI for smoother graphics.
  New Aim Laser Effect – More precise targeting for an even more satisfying experience.
 Performance Metrics – Track your skills with 'Longest Streak' and 'Average Speed (m/s)'!


Steam-Specific Features

 Custom Levels Support – Drop your songs into the new CustomLevels folder and create your own charts!
 Chromapper Tutorial Map – A step-by-step guide with comments to help you master custom mapping.

notes.title: Feel the Rhythm of Solar Black with the Cybersymphony II Update
notes.content:
Cybersymphony II is OUT! This new FREE update is now live with the 1.45 release! Dive into a whole new dimension of rhythmic action with this stellar update packed with fresh content, enhanced visuals, and gameplay improvements. Here is what you can expect:

New Musical Additions
The Cybersymphony II update brings classical music into the mix, with two iconic tracks by Tchaikovsky:
"Russian Dance": A high-energy piece that pushes players to slice, shoot, and dodge with precision.
"Romeo & Juliet": A dramatic composition that immerses players in an intense rhythmic battle.

Explore New Worlds
In addition to the new music, two brand-new stages expand the universe of SolarBlack:

 Waves: Dive into a futuristic dimension where sound waves pulse through every corner, offering a fresh auditory and visual experience.
 Dokholo Ga-Tsogwe: Take a rhythmic journey through the South African savannah, where nature and music collide in a breathtakingly immersive environment.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772833/e4a3c6655c000fc8d6d0b3bdb1dcee0e61e4c85e.jpg

Quest 3 Graphics Overhaul
Players on Quest 3 will notice significant visual upgrades. What’s new in this update:

 Postprocessing Effects: Enhanced visual effects for greater immersion.
 HDR Support: High Dynamic Range support brings out the vibrant colors and dynamic lighting of each world.
 Bloom and Color Correction: Realistic glow effects and refined color settings make every scene pop with life.


Enhanced Gameplay
SolarBlack’s gameplay receives a significant boost with this update. Aside from smoother gameplay with optimized performance, expect these changes:

 Spatial Sounds for SaberGuns: Audio enhancements that provide a more immersive experience as you slice and shoot to the beat.
 Improved Auto-aim: More accurate and responsive targeting ensures that every shot counts.
 Light Improvements and New Saber Trail: Enhanced lighting effects and a redesigned saber trail add to the game’s dynamic visuals.


New Features and Fixes
The update also introduces several user-requested features:

 "No Obstacle" Mode: A new gameplay modifier that lets players focus on pure rhythmic action. No dodging needed!
 Styled Selection Hub: A refreshed design for a more intuitive start.
 Pause Menu Countdown: A countdown timer will begin when resuming from pause mode, ensuring players have time to get back into their groove.
 Username Selection Prompt: Players will be prompted to set their username at startup if not yet set.


Finally, a bug causing the game to stay paused due to focus loss has been resolved, ensuring smoother gameplay.

notes.title: Feel the Rhythm of Solar Black with the Cybersymphony Update
notes.content:
Get ready to experience new adventures and brand-new songs with our latest update: Cybersymphony.
Start your journey with 3 NEW levels, and 2 NEW songs!

NEW ENVIRONMENTS

Sentinel Mode

 Haven City, 2067: Step into the future with our Cyberpunk City level. Experience technology and dystopian visuals colliding to create an unforgettable journey.
 Crystal Falls: Discover the beauty of the breathtaking landscapes of South Africa, where nature meets tranquillity.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772833/a1f92a08dfeba3611c4ccbf2d45445cec77cb95a.png

Discovery Mode

 Letho: Explore the fiery depths of a new volcanic level that promises an adventure like no other. Feel the heat as you navigate through this incandescent environment.


NEW SONGS

 Vivaldi - Winter: Let the chilling melodies of Vivaldi's Winter accompany you through your journey.
 Strauss - Also Sprach Zarathustra: You'll recognise this piece as a popular choice in Sci-Fi media. Embark on an epic adventure with the powerful notes of Strauss, enhancing the intensity of your gameplay.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772833/1d86bc7fb08dcf6cea7ae86d3c2aea091b3a428f.png

But that's not all... We're also giving you some sweet optimizations:

 Post-Processing Improvements: Experience a visually richer environment with enhanced post-processing, including bloom and HDR.
 Shader Fine-Tuning: Enjoy refined visuals, with shader optimizations ensuring a smoother, and more immersive gameplay experience.


Ready to dive in yet? Begin your journey with the Cybersymphony update now! 

Thank You For Playing,
Niel ːauyayː

notes.title: SolarBlack Song Pack Vol. 2 update is now available - and FREE!
notes.content:
Two new songs are available for FREE in the game!

[previewyoutube=DR2FJd50EOQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings interstellar travelers 🚀

This new update brings a few new tweaks and brand-new soundtracks to your system at home. Here is what you can expect in this update:

TWO NEW SONGS
Just like the universe, our song list is expanding slowly but surely.

If you are a Beat Saber gamer, there is a high chance that you are familiar with the high-intensity tracks of Schwank’s music. Pump up the beat with ‘Fresh!’ by Schwank when you fire up SolarBlack as part of your fitness routine.

Alternatively, you could rock out to Rohrenreit12’s ‘Think’ if your workout routine is lacking a little bit of rock n’ roll.

UI ADJUSTMENTS
After the update, you will notice a few adjustments in different areas.
If you suddenly feel the need for a refresher on how to play SolarBlack, hop into the tutorial and you will now see additional text info at the beginning of the tutorial.
Differentiators for Different Difficulties in Discovery Mode. Now that is a lot of ‘D’s.

We hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Update Notes December 1, 2023
notes.content: Resolved a tutorial issue that was introduced in the latest update.

notes.title: Update Notes November 28, 2023
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Changes in this build:


Recentering Options:
 Implemented recentering across all native recenter systems.
 Removed the ability to recenter through right thumbstick click.
 Disabled automatic recentering after each scene transition.

Gameplay Enhancement:
 No-Fail mode is now activated by default, offering a seamless onboarding experience. This mode allows scores to be recorded.
 Increased the force applied to cut objects for a more impactful experience.

SDK and Audio Updates:
 Integrated the latest SDKs for improved functionality.
 Upgraded to the newest spatial audio technology.

Audio Experience:
 Introduced new audio effects and fine-tuned existing ones.

notes.title: Update 1.25
notes.content:
Introduced 3 New Gameplay Modifiers:

  No Shoot Mode (Sentinel)
  No Runners (Discovery)
 Infinite Ammo

Added Features And Fixes:

 Enhanced the user interface (UI) for a more seamless experience.
 Implemented the option to select albums, reducing content loading times.
 Added a countdown timer for resuming the game after pausing.
 Improved sword shine effects for a more visually appealing experience.
 Enhanced the in-game points display, now disappearing during pauses.
 Various performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.
 Improved graphics, including better sphere and glass reflections.
 Enhanced physics and hitting logic for a more realistic feel.
 Improved floor collision mechanics.
 Sound improvements for a more immersive audio experience.
 Addressed an issue where the slow-motion ring wasn't empty on game start in some cases.
 Leaderboard refresh fixed.
 Include a step in the text tutorial on how to reset the viewing direction.

notes.title: Update Notes August 21 2023
notes.content:
Fix for a physics bug that caused hit detection misses on some systems.
 Bug resolved: Settings now save correctly.
 Improved color selection: Color now changes after dragging.
 SaberGun color update: Default colors changed to green and purple.
 Minor adjustments made to target colliders.
